name: BDD100K: A Diverse Driving Video Dataset
description: A diverse, large-scale driving video dataset collected by Berkeley AI Research (BAIR) at the University of California, Berkeley. Comprises 100,000 high-definition dashcam video clips (40 seconds each at 30 fps) capturing geographic, environmental, weather, and time-of-day diversity across New York, San Francisco Bay Area, and other major US regions. Supports heterogeneous multi-task learning with ground truth for 2D bounding boxes, instance segmentation, drivable area segmentation, lane markings, multiple-object tracking, and pose estimation.
